tasks.title: Verify a rule-worker-done claim
tasks.brief: Claim: plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/reconcile.mjs ~line 140: when a rule has last_run_at, `rule-worker-done` fires if result.updated_at > last_run_at without checking result.outcome === 'complete' (the no-last_run_at branch checks it). A live backlog/improve worker writing a `working` result gets flagged and the coordinator would close it mid-run. Repro: rule {id:scan,kind:backlog,last_run_at:2026-01-01T00:00:00Z,worker:{status:running,result:scan-result.json}} + result {"updated_at":"2026-01-01T00:05:00Z","outcome":"working"}; run `node reconcile.mjs FILE` on a scratch copy in $TMPDIR. Verify and propose the fix and test (reconcile.test.cjs rule-worker test, stamp() takes an outcome).

tasks.title: Scope a dashboard change
tasks.brief:
Task (user words): "dont need this 'moved task' text in there. when I unblock/move a task, it should fade from the list (make it something like 300ms) and nothing else is needed". The text is the status message at the top of the docked task list, e.g. `Moved "TITLE" to Implementation. Comment saved; awaiting factory acknowledgement.`
Job: in plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/dashboard.html find that message, the existing row fade-out (departing rows, reduced-motion handling) and its duration, and every place/test that references the message. Propose the smallest change: remove the success message (keep error/conflict messages), make the departing row fade last 300ms, keep reduced-motion behavior. List tests to update.

tasks.title: Reject --expected-revision on a new task
tasks.brief: `node plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/factory.mjs FILE --task NEW --expected-revision N` on a task that does not exist returns a ConflictError that says to reload and retry. That can never succeed. Make it a usage error with the message `--expected-revision applies only to existing tasks.` (an ordinary Error, not a ConflictError). The factory file must stay unchanged. Add a regression test to plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/factory.test.cjs.

tasks.title: Flag branch-ahead only for local-merge tasks
tasks.brief: plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/reconcile.mjs reports `branch-ahead` for tasks that have an issue or a PR. Those tasks land on GitHub, so the finding is noise for them. Report `branch-ahead` only for tasks that land by local merge (no issue and no PR). Keep the finding shape unchanged. Update the text in plugins/factory/AGENTS.md and plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/SKILL.md that describes it. Add a test to plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/reconcile.test.cjs.

tasks.title: Add the pr.merged broker event
tasks.brief:
Add a broker event `pr.merged` to plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/broker.mjs. Spec:
- It needs `--task` (`task: true`).
- Its data keys are `pr` and `merge_commit`; both are required. A missing `merge_commit` makes `emit` exit 2 with a message that contains `needs "merge_commit"`.
- `--source` defaults to `worker`, as for every other event.
- `wait` returns it like any other event.
- The `emit` help text lists the event and says it is a hint from the implementation worker (role, pr, merge_commit, head) that the factory verifies on GitHub.
Document the event in plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/SKILL.md and plugins/factory/AGENTS.md. Add tests to plugins/factory/skills/lifecycle/broker.test.cjs.
